contract: Require projected shared vertices within each bounded partition to follow one exact common endpoint path. This rejects a partition whose cells meet at the initial state but tear apart along the linear sweep. It supplements, and does not replace, the parent exact-common-translation, exact complete-cover, horizontal-plane, matched parent-vertex, and same-patch-ID trajectory checks.

whole_sweep_contact_audit.relative_gap: The right-minus-left plane offset is affine in t because each parent follows exact linear common translation and remains horizontal. It may start separated, reach zero, and end interpenetrating; the geometric certificate deliberately does not require a positive final gap.
whole_sweep_contact_audit.contact_ownership: The shortcut is reached only for two exact full cohesive covers built from active, non-dormant mixed-mode patches. Each matching patch remains geometrically paired for all t, and shared projected vertices remain coherent. The mixed cohesive law has a compression branch (stiffness.z * normal gap when normal gap <= 0) and an intact/damage-scaled tensile branch for positive normal gap, so crossing the interface does not leave an uncovered contact complement in this exact axis-normal case.
whole_sweep_contact_audit.limits: This is source-level geometric reasoning plus CPU guards, not a native contact-force or physical qualification. It relies on the declared mixed cohesive law being the intended contact response for the fully covered interface; it does not qualify dormant patches, incomplete coverage, tangential slip, rotation, deformation, non-axis-aligned planes, or other contact models.
